observations.operation: test ReadArgs result slot 3 (PROP); when set, branch around the returned-font proportional check
when PROP is clear, test bit 5 at opened TextFont+0x17 (TextFont.Flags FPF_PROPORTIONAL); continue if clear
if the opened font is proportional and PROP is clear, call graphics.library/CloseFont, clear the font pointer and set IoErr to 212 (ERROR_OBJECT_WRONG_TYPE)

layout_evidence.source: CopperSharp SDK Graphics.TextFont field order and FontFlags enum; offsets agree with the HUNK access

conclusion: PROP sets the TextAttr proportional request and also allows OpenDiskFont to return a proportional font; without PROP, a proportional result is closed and rejected with ERROR_OBJECT_WRONG_TYPE.
evidence_limits: This is static HUNK evidence; original Workbench diskfont selection behavior and diagnostics still require guest comparison.
